title: Juicy Charred Peruvian Seafood Ceviche Clasico
description: A halal-friendly Peruvian dish featuring charred seafood and stir-fry vegetables, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Heat a skillet over high heat and char the shrimp and scallops for 2 minutes per side.
Remove the seafood from the skillet and set aside to cool.
In the same skillet, sauté the red onion and ají amarillo pepper for 3 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled seafood, sautéed onion and pepper mixture, and chopped cilantro.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top of the seafood mixture and toss to coat.
Season the ceviche with salt to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the ceviche cold, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
